substantive_decisions.accepted: Fully accept Codex framework of candidate relative response under shared prior high-tier pressure E in S-10..S-1, measuring prelaunch return, drawdown, rebound and cross-sectional rank over E-1..S-1 strictly before signal date S.
substantive_decisions.retracted: Formally retracted false claim of 'no >=5 shock' on 2024-08-15 and 2023-12-20; retracted arbitrary manual thresholds (30亿, 8%, 15%, rank 0.3/0.8); retracted unverified narrative assumptions of lockup/smart money.
preserved_disagreements: Theoretical gap in prolonged low-space regimes when no >=5 stock exists in 10-day window; proposed dual-hierarchy shock: primary >=5 limit-down shock (E_high5), fallback to space ceiling leader >=3 limit-down shock (E_space).
Same-day rank missingness handling: distinguish strict 100%-cohort rank vs observed-subcohort rank to avoid zeroing out valid peer comparisons due to a single invalid row.
